# lily pad and frogspawn with `use` on a source water surface, then on flowing water and on stone
B 4 -60 -3 minecraft:water[level=0]
B 4 -59 -3 minecraft:lily_pad
I A 0 minecraft:lily_pad*7
I A 40 minecraft:frogspawn*8
EV sound at=4.5,-58.5,-2.5 r=16.0 ex=1 event=minecraft:block.lily_pad.place source=block vol=1.0 pitch=0.8
B 6 -60 -3 minecraft:water[level=0]
B 6 -59 -3 minecraft:frogspawn
I A 0 minecraft:lily_pad*7
I A 40 minecraft:frogspawn*7
EV sound at=6.5,-58.5,-2.5 r=16.0 ex=1 event=minecraft:block.frogspawn.place source=block vol=1.0 pitch=0.8
B 20 -60 -3 minecraft:water[level=0]
B 20 -59 -3 minecraft:lily_pad
I C 0 minecraft:lily_pad*8
EV sound at=20.5,-58.5,-2.5 r=16.0 ex=1 event=minecraft:block.lily_pad.place source=block vol=1.0 pitch=0.8
B 8 -60 -3 minecraft:stone
I A 0 minecraft:lily_pad*7
I A 40 minecraft:frogspawn*7
B 12 -60 -3 minecraft:water[level=3]

I A 40 minecraft:frogspawn*7

# powder snow bucket: on the top of stone, into water, into an air block clicked directly and beside a fence; creative keeps the bucket

EV sound at=8.5,-59.5,3.5 r=16.0 ex=1 event=minecraft:item.bucket.empty_powder_snow source=block vol=1.0 pitch=0.8

# a command block: only a creative operator can place it (canUseGameMasterBlocks), the data is applied for that player
T 14
BE 16 -60 8 -
BEU 16 -60 8 -
I A 0 minecraft:command_block*1{minecraft:block_entity_data:{Command:"say hi",TrackOutput:0b,id:"minecraft:command_block"}}
I A 40 minecraft:frogspawn*8
BE 20 -60 8 -
BEU 20 -60 8 -
I B 0 minecraft:command_block*1{minecraft:block_entity_data:{Command:"say hi",TrackOutput:0b,id:"minecraft:command_block"}}
BE 24 -60 8 -
BEU 24 -60 8 -
I C 0 minecraft:command_block*1{minecraft:block_entity_data:{Command:"say hi",TrackOutput:0b,id:"minecraft:command_block"}}
B 36 -60 8 minecraft:command_block[conditional=false,facing=north]
BE 36 -60 8 {Command:"say hi",SuccessCount:0,TrackOutput:0b,UpdateLastExecution:1b,auto:0b,components:{},conditionMet:0b,id:"minecraft:command_block",powered:0b,x:36,y:-60,z:8}
BEU 36 -60 8 -
I D 0 minecraft:command_block*1{minecraft:block_entity_data:{Command:"say hi",TrackOutput:0b,id:"minecraft:command_block"}}
EV sound at=36.5,-59.5,8.5 r=16.0 ex=1 event=minecraft:block.stone.place source=block vol=1.0 pitch=0.8
